summary.text: Tighe Galvin is the Libertarian candidate for the Nevada State Assembly, District 21, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where incumbent Elaine Marzola (D) and Patsy Carvalho (R) are also on the ballot.
A teacher, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is a special education teacher born and raised in Nevada.

paragraphs.text: Tighe Galvin earned a high school diploma from Green Valley High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas in 2025.
According to Ballotpedia, his career experience includes working as a teacher.
In the survey, Galvin said he is passionate about making government as limited and transparent as possible.
He said he would fight for local control, reform the Clark County School District, and support small and local businesses.
